verdict: High-production motion-design ad: white canvas, blue accent, 3D devices and liquid morph transitions (sheet_1/2).
Clear 3-beat: drop file -> progress bar -> Done with confetti (frames 110-500).
Button click is shown by zooming the row to isolate the control and recolouring the button (frames 720-780).
No hard cuts; every transition is a morph, scale or fly-in, average shot ~99 frames.
Kinetic typography with one blue keyword per phrase carries the narration; cursor hand is stylised, not real.
